verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical: the details are squeezed into a narrow, ragged column that breaks into orphaned fragments ('13, 11 a.m.', 'Church', 'ave, 2-3'). The stained-glass window runs from the top edge to the bottom edge of the canvas, and the headline wraps to an orphaned 'Sunday'. In A the date/address column sits almost against the window's right edge with no gutter. B leaves a slightly larger gap, so it is marginally less cramped, but both have a jammed right side and dead space on the left.
